overview_description.description: TrueVault is the first data security company entirely focused on protecting Personally Identifiable Information (PII). TrueVault decouples consumer identity from consumer behavior to eliminate data security risks and compliance liabilities, giving companies only the data they need. As organizations collect and store more data to drive their businesses forward, they are simultaneously increasing their risk and liability. TrueVault removes 100 percent of that liability and ensures compliance with regulations such as HIPAA, GDPR, and the California Privacy Act.

product.name: Hosted Privacy Center
product.description: A managed online hub where consumers can learn about a business's privacy practices and exercise their privacy rights.

product.name: Request Handling
product.description: A dashboard and automation system to track, manage, and process consumer privacy requests efficiently.

product.name: Privacy Notices
product.description: Flexible, customizable privacy notices that businesses can deploy to inform consumers about data collection and usage.

product.name: Vendor Privacy Monitoring
product.description: A service that tracks and monitors over 2,500 vendors to assess how they handle customer data and ensure compliance.

product.name: Consent Management Platform (CMP)
product.description: A platform to track and manage website visitor consent, including cookie consent and other opt-in/opt-out preferences.
